title: 村晚
author: Lei Zhen

translation: grass fills the pond and water brims the bank
the hills hold the setting sun and soak the cold ripples
a herding boy goes home, lying across his ox's back
a short flute plays whatever tune comes to his lips

appreciation: The pond, the hills holding the sun and the cold ripples make a still, luminous evening frame. Into it rides a shepherd boy lying sideways on his ox, playing a flute with no tune at all. The freedom of that careless music is the poem's real subject, and it makes the whole scene feel warm.
